patches.fit_note: Continuous exposed south tower facade, 6 x 10.5 m, with two columns and three storeys. All 6,300 native support samples on a 0.1 m lattice are covered. Surveyed near-vertical source core depths span 42.236 to 42.912 m; the new plane is 42.7 m. Original collision is preserved; visual and collider surfaces do not match exactly. Camera visibility requires a separate source-render study.

limits: Reconstruction covers two coherent, surveyed facade sections rather than the entire island.
The buried west facade was removed after integration previews showed poor visibility. The current south tower face requires integrated preview inspection.
